newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil real ends off 0.09 pct on lower mini-band.
newsitem.headline: Brazil real ends off 0.09 pct on lower mini-band.

text.p: Brazil's real closed down 0.09 percent at 1.0446 per dollar in the commercial forex market after the Central Bank set a weaker mini-band for the currency at 1.0445 to 1.0495 per dollar, dealers said.
The previous mini-band was set on Friday between 1.0435 and 1.0485 reais to the dollar.
With today's 0.1 percent lowering, the mini-band has declined 0.53 percent so far this month. In the last few months, the mini-band was lowered between 0.50 percent and 0.65 percent.
Most of players are now expecting only one more lowering of the mini-band this month, a 0.05 percent decline on Friday, dealers said.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real followed the lowering in the mini-band closing at 1.0503 to the dollar, down 0.1 percent.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.45 percent to end at 1.095 per dollar.
